quotes.text: We had a great ash scattering event that was coordinated by Lupita and her crew last weekend. Event was occurred on time and well prepared. Great support was provided to ensure that we have a successful trip and safety was warranted. Reasonable package deal is a plus and we highly recommend it to families and groups are looking for ask scattering services.

The only thing we would have changed would have been to add another hour to our cruise. People were having so much fun, and the views of the Bay were a spectacular backdrop to the event, no one wanted it to end.

Absolutely the best choice we made for our wedding. Everything went like clockwork, without a hitch. The food was outstanding in quality and presentation. The premium liquor package was just that, premium.
Really, no one else compares. Their yacht is beautifully maintained, they are incredibly flexible, and they have great prices. Our wedding day aboard the Empress yacht was absolutely beautiful.
We stumbled across Empress while trying to find alternatives to the “other” yachts, and I’m so glad we did! They were flexible and let us pick and choose.
Gerry took the boat underneath the Golden Gate Bridge, providing a view I think very few of our guests had ever seen.
